limitations: Scores are provisional browser judgments; physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, OS sharing, notifications and native performance remain deferred without blanket score deductions.
Corresponding scale, transition and repeated fixture variants are grouped under their settled screen or state family.
Runtime results are supplied evidence, not independently rerun checks; still images alone do not establish interaction behavior.
Chronological filmstrips were inspected as still sequences, not watched as video; browser performance judgments rely on the separate supplied timing measurements.
Fixture forecasts, explanations and synthetic source text establish layout coverage only, not predictive or semantic quality.
Billing and navigator.share are simulated; connected social behavior and actual payments are not demonstrated.
No evidence demonstrates repeated novice-use outcomes sufficient for exemplary 10 scores.

The enlarged background-source qualification is materially compromised by its parchment silhouette; apply the essential-readability gate of overall at most 5 to that screen and passage component until corrected.
Other content extending beyond a screenshot is not treated as unreachable when supplied browser evidence establishes scrolling or retrieval.
The requested A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met; several observed browser deficiencies remain independently of deferred native verification.
topFixes: Fix evidence parchment safe insets first: decorative cuts must never cross source qualifications, question labels or explanation text.
Keep room paintings visible throughout navigation and synchronize background focus with foreground composition.
Compact centered 200% explanation, profile and outcome groups so controls remain closely connected to their context.
Separate the long reveal/share action stacks into clear purpose groups with consistent disclosure and navigation cues.
Ensure enlarged invitation content clears anchored footers, and make overflow inside constrained writing fields explicit.
Refine repeated parchment and wood edge thickness, contact shadows and star-panel integration without adding visual noise.
